Name: Mail Order Mod
Author: spro2go
Description:
[size=6][b]Mail Order Mod[/b][/size]

Mail Order Mod is a Stardew Valley mod that allows players to place orders at Pierre’s Seed Shop even after business hours. You can slip an order form under the door and receive your items in the mail the very next morning.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list][*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b]
[*][b]Mail Framework Mod[/b]
[*] [b]Stardew Valley[/b] [b]1.6[/b]
[/list]

[size=5][b]How to Use[/b][/size] 
Walk up to Pierre’s Seed Shop door when the shop is closed. Right-click (or use your Action button) on the door. A dialogue will appear confirming the shop is closed and offering to take an order slip. Select your items and pay as usual. Check your mailbox the next morning to claim your goods!
